psychological_meaning: Olivine is a gentle and reassuring color, embodying growth, renewal, and harmony. It evokes feelings of nature, peace, and well-being. Olivine can promote feelings of optimism, balance, and connection to the earth, making it a soothing and grounding choice.

real_world_examples.title: Olive Tree
real_world_examples.description: The leaves of the olive tree exhibit a distinctive olivine hue, symbolizing peace and prosperity.

real_world_examples.title: Olivine Gemstone
real_world_examples.description: The gemstone peridot, often referred to as olivine, showcases the color's natural beauty and vibrancy.

how_to_pair: Combine with earthy browns for a natural look.
Use with creams or whites for a soft, serene palette.
Accent with gold for a touch of elegance.
